Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mohd. Safdar, Advocate for the applicant.
Mrs. Meenakshi Sharma, A.G.A. for the
State of Uttarakhand.
2. This first bail application has been moved
by the applicant seeking regular bail in F.I.R./
Case Crime No.88 of 2026, under Section 3,
Section 5 read with Section 11 of Uttarakhand
Protection of Cow Progeny Act, registered at
Police Station Piran Kaliyar, District Haridwar.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits
that the applicant has been falsely implicated in
the present case and has been languishing in
judicial custody since 02.05.2026. It is further
submitted that, as per the prosecution version,
the applicant was apprehended from an
agricultural field where the alleged slaughter of
cow progeny was stated to have taken place.
However, no independent witness is stated to
have witnessed or corroborated the applicant's
arrest. Learned counsel further submits that the
co-accused, namely, Shadab, has already been
enlarged on bail by a Coordinate Bench of this
Court in BA1 No. 1060 of 2026, vide order dated
29.09.2026. It is, therefore, contended that the
applicant is entitled to bail on the ground of
parity.
4. Per contra, learned State Counsel has
vehemently opposed the prayer for bail. She
submits that the applicant has one criminal
antecedent, a fact which is not disputed by
learned counsel for the applicant. However,

learned counsel for the applicant submits that
the applicant has not been convicted in the said
case and that the trial therein is still pending.
5. Having considered the submissions
advanced by learned counsel for the parties and
upon perusal of the material available on record,
this Court finds that the co-accused, namely,
Shadab, has already been granted bail by a
Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated
29.09.2026 in BA1 No. 1060 of 2026. The
applicant has been in judicial custody since
02.05.2026, and the criminal antecedent referred
to by the learned State Counsel relates to a case
in which the applicant has not been convicted
and the trial is stated to be pending. In the facts
and circumstances of the case, without
expressing any opinion on the merits of the
allegations and keeping in view the principle of
parity, this Court is of the considered view that
the applicant has made out a case for grant of
bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
7. Let the applicant be released on bail, on
executing personal bond and furnishing two
reliable sureties, each of like amount, to the
satisfaction of Court concerned.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 14.10.2026
Arpan
